t: Flomasta PipeGrip Reducing Tee is a push-fit water pipe solution for connecting 22mm pipe to 15mm pipe in a Y-shaped tee. Its dual locking system and green band indicator ensure a secure, leak-free connection with no hot works needed. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, it’s perfect for branching out in space-limited areas.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
No Hot Works: Quick & Safe Installation
